name: Gloin Ironfoot
portraitDescription: Strong and broad-shouldered, with skin tones often lighter than hill dwarves. Known for their strength and craftsmanship. Wearing a soot-stained leather apron, carrying a heavy hammer, looking muscular and hardworking. The character's appearance strongly complements their class and job, looking rugged and professional. Key features: thick beard, broad shoulders, heavy plate armor, ornate metalwork.
